label: The first moment at the far end
section: The first moment at the far end
subgoals: Find the resistance each capacitor shares with the path to the node
Negate the sum and convert ohm femtofarads to picoseconds

label: The first moment at an inner node
section: The first moment at an inner node
subgoals: Identify which capacitors lie beyond the node
Charge every capacitor's contribution through the resistance shared with the node
Sum and negate for the inner-node moment

label: The second moment

Weight each capacitor by its shared resistance and its node's first moment
Sum and negate for the second moment
